description: Source code for the ProducerQueueChannel class managing buffer queues in a buffer hub service, including buffer allocation, insertion, removal, and message handling.

classes.name: ProducerQueueChannel
classes.description: Manages a producer queue in a buffer hub, handling buffer allocation, insertion, removal, and communication with consumer channels.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ProducerQueueChannel instance with configuration and usage policies.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and dispatches to appropriate remote methods.

methods.name: HandleImpulse
methods.description: Handles impulse messages (no implementation details provided).

methods.name: GetBufferInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the buffer queue, including capacity and usage policy.

methods.name: OnCreateConsumerQueue
methods.description: Creates a new consumer queue channel and registers existing buffers.

methods.name: OnGetQueueInfo
methods.description: Returns current queue configuration and buffer ID.

methods.name: OnProducerQueueAllocateBuffers
methods.description: Allocates multiple buffers with specified parameters, respecting usage policies.

methods.name: AllocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a single buffer, creates a producer channel, and registers it.

methods.name: OnProducerQueueInsertBuffer
methods.description: Inserts an existing buffer into the queue after validation.

methods.name: OnProducerQueueRemoveBuffer
methods.description: Removes a buffer from the queue at a specified slot.

methods.name: AddConsumer
methods.description: Adds a consumer channel to the list of consumers.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Removes a consumer channel from the list of consumers.
